upstream_body: Open Secure AI Alliance / Linux Foundation
upstream_state: Proposal; final production schema and approved submission interface are not established by this adapter.
corrections: SAFE means Shared AI Findings Exchange, not Security Analysis Findings Exchange.
The old illustrative scanner fields are not a verified official SAFE JSON schema.
Illustrative scanner outputs do not establish executed GSPC measurements, confidence intervals, signatures or a quorum.
Public claim maintenance and private incident evidence require separate disclosure paths.

pipeline.action: Authenticated tenant and operator context must come from the host.
pipeline.implementation: Local self-case integration only; external authenticated intake is not provided.

pipeline.action: Account for prompts, model traces, tool calls, system logs, configuration, safeguard versions and approval events.
pipeline.implementation: Bounded private files checked by digest or explicitly missing/not applicable.

pipeline.action: Preserve method, configuration, runtime, scope and outcome.
pipeline.implementation: Record-consistency gate, not proof of original execution or arbitrary model inference.

pipeline.action: Bind a reported negative result to the same declared method, configuration, runtime and scope.
pipeline.implementation: Synthetic gate tests do not substitute for an earlier operation missing its own control.

pipeline.action: Keep proposal, authorised execution and comparable retest separate.
pipeline.implementation: Comparison gate only; no fix executor.

pipeline.action: Purpose-specific review, redaction and audience approval.
pipeline.implementation: Sharing disabled; no public incident export.

gspc_axis_mapping.governance: actor and approval-scope checks where a declared contract exists
gspc_axis_mapping.provenance: source, method, version and digest lineage
gspc_axis_mapping.conformance: declared schema and executable contract tests
gspc_axis_mapping.other_axes: NOT_APPLICABLE without an explicit matching contract

deadline_policy.reason: Draft intervals are not universal legal duties. A verified applicable policy, trigger and calendar are required before timers.

privacy.note: Unsalted hashes of low-entropy sensitive content are not a privacy substitute.

does_not_prove: Official SAFE conformance, exchange acceptance or institutional endorsement.
Safety, legal compliance, source truth or successful original execution from a signature alone.
